ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.desc: Lets your desktop show through the app window, blurred by the system. On by default on macOS where the system supports it, and off elsewhere. Text stays readable on every theme: the slider stops before any theme's text gets hard to read.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.rest: Restart Local Operator to apply this change. The window keeps its current look until then.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.unsu: Translucent window is unavailable because Reduce transparency is on in your system accessibility settings. Turn it off there to enable this control.
Translucent window needs Windows 11 version 22H2 or later.

Translucent window is not available on Linux: there is no native window blur an app can request. Desktop translucency there depends on the compositor (X11 or Wayland) and can fall back to software blur, which would show the desktop's text through the app's.
Translucent window is not available on this platform: only macOS is verified to composite a blurred window, and the Windows 11 material is not verified on a real machine yet.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.cove: Which parts of the window go translucent. Sidebars only leaves the conversation and pages solid. Full app also covers them and the side panels; web pages, documents and images shown inside stay solid.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.inte: Left is frosted: mostly solid with a hint of the desktop. Right is see-through, as clear as every theme's text allows. Message blocks and cards become tints, inputs stay distinct from the glass, and code, documents and images stay solid.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.mate: The system material behind the app. It also sets how far see-through can go.
ui.settings.appearance.window_glass.unsu: Translucent window is not offered on Windows yet: Mica and Acrylic are implemented but have not been tested on a real Windows machine, so the control stays off until that testing lands.

Translucent window is unavailable because the GPU cannot composite it right now: compositing or rasterisation is disabled or running in software. A driver update or leaving a remote session may bring the control back without a restart.
Translucent window is unavailable because hardware acceleration is off for this launch (--disable-gpu or a crash fallback). Relaunch with acceleration on to use it.
Translucent window is unavailable because this renderer cannot draw a backdrop blur.
